text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I are having a
meeting, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My apologies. It seems yesterday has
left a
lingering effect on me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
En route to the academy, I found myself
in the
rain's sweet embrace. I indulged
said opportunity
until I arrived at the
dorm.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The exhibition we wove together was
both
magical and rife with passion...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Even now, my head still spins from the

spectacle—the heat pulsing through my
whole
being!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, how I wish you could have seen it,
Trainer!
Haaah ha ha ha—
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She's definitely caught a cold. I send her
home to
get some rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
